title: Shared Scientific World Manifest 0.1.0 (proposed contract)
description: Additive, non-destructive catalog and scientific world-data interfaces for existing Godot projects. Structural validity is not scientific validation or proof of engine readiness. See tools/validate_manifest.py and README_validation.md.

reference.description: Opaque identity tuple. Preserve native id text; namespace disambiguates existing duplicate local IDs. These are instance references, resolved by the semantic validator, not JSON Schema $ref.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension keys, for example groundwork:native. Extensions never override core semantics.

vertical_reference.description: Height meaning is independent of horizontal CRS and ecological reference elevations. Null means unknown, never zero.

scale_mapping.description: IR 0.2.0 convention divides source displacement by these ratios. Already authored positions must not be divided again.

representation.description: Fictional authored landscapes need no real-world compression ratio or real parcel mapping.

grid.description: Contract heightfield samples are vertices. Source raster pixel registration is separately retained in source_raster; never add or drop a pixel implicitly.

source_locator.description: Recovery locator into immutable source bytes, not an ID-generation recipe to rerun after edits.
